definitions.full: H3277. yael I. [ יָעֵל ] noun [masculine] mountain-goat (Late Hebrew id. ; יְעֵיעָא ᵑ7 , Syriac ; Arabic , ; Assyrian ia'ilu Dl S 53 (but Hpt BAS i. 170 , Jäger ib. 465 ); Ethiopic see Hom NS 280 ) — Plural יְעֵלִים Psa 104:18 (|| שְׁפַנִּים ); ׳הַיּ צוּרֵי 1Sam 24:3 ; יַעֲלֵיסָֿ֑לַע Job 39:1 (|| אַיָּלוֺת ; compare I. יַעֲלָה ).
